newsitem.title: SWEDEN: FORECAST - Sweden Oct c/a seen at 5.8 bln crowns.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Sweden Oct c/a seen at 5.8 bln crowns.

text.p: Sweden's current account for October was expected to show a surplus of 5.8 billion crowns, a Reuters poll of 15 analysts showed.
Forecasts ranged between 4.2 billion and 7.0 billion crowns.
For full year 1996 the current account was expected to show a surplus of about 51 billion crowns, the average of analysts' forecasts showed. Forecasts varied between 46 and 60 billion crowns.
In September the current account showed a surplus of 5.2 billion crowns and in October 1995 a surplus of 3.7 billion crowns.
The Riksbank will publish the October current account figures on December 19 at 1100 GMT.

Analysts who participated in the poll were from Aragon, Carnegie, Chase, Consensus, Den Danske Bank, Deutsche Morgan Grenfell, Hagstromer & Qviberg, Handelsbanken, J P Morgan, Lehman Brothers, Nomura Bank, PaineWebber, Salomon Brothers, Swedbank and Transferator.
